cards.title: 紅水桶站錯地方
cards.whisper_en: That is not where it should stand.

edits.corridor: Edit the existing corridor photo: place a faded old red plastic duty bucket upside-down balanced impossibly in the middle of the empty corridor floor.

cards.title: 拖把水痕爬牆了
cards.whisper_en: The wet trail climbs up the wall.

edits.corridor: Edit the existing corridor photo: add a dark wet mop trail on the floor that impossibly leaves the floor and runs vertically up the corridor wall.
edits.door: Edit the existing classroom door photo: show every classroom door along the corridor left ajar open by the same narrow dark gap.
edits.classroom: Edit the existing classroom photo: add a dark wet mop streak that runs from the floor vertically up the classroom wall beside the blackboard.

cards.edit: Edit the existing corridor photo: add a dark wet mop trail on the floor that impossibly leaves the floor and runs vertically up the corridor wall.

cards.title: 排名貼滿了牆
cards.whisper: 名字都不見了，只剩名次。
cards.whisper_en: The names are gone, only ranks remain.

edits.corridor: Edit the existing corridor photo: stretch the corridor to look impossibly long vanishing to a tiny point, and cover both walls floor-to-ceiling with many blank off-white ranking sheets with no readable text, no letters, no numbers.
edits.classroom: Edit the existing classroom photo: add tall stacks of blank test papers with no readable text piled up to the ceiling along the back wall, with faint red pen circles and strokes but no words or numbers.

cards.title: 老師不叫名字
cards.title_en: The Teacher Never Calls My Name
cards.whisper_en: That chair is still waiting outside the door.

edits.corridor: Edit the existing corridor photo: duplicate the same classroom door repeating into an impossibly distant corridor, and add a dark out-of-focus adult silhouette far away at the end with back turned, no face visible.
edits.door: Edit the existing classroom door photo: place one single empty wooden student chair alone outside the closed door facing the wall, and lower the ceiling to hang far too low over it.

cards.edit: Edit the existing corridor photo: duplicate the same classroom door repeating into an impossibly distant corridor, and add a dark out-of-focus adult silhouette far away at the end with back turned, no face visible.

cards.title: 沒人面向我
cards.whisper_en: The banyan watches me from outside.

edits.corridor: Edit the existing corridor photo: move all windows to the wrong side of the corridor and tilt the floor sideways, with dense dark banyan tree branches and leaves pressing against the glass from outside.
edits.door: Edit the existing classroom door photo: line up pairs of white sneakers and canvas shoes neatly under the doorway edge as if left behind, no people.
edits.classroom: Edit the existing classroom photo: mirror the room layout and push every desk and chair away to the edges leaving one single desk alone in the middle, with a Taiwanese school bag hanging on every desk and a short-sleeved white school shirt with navy trim draped over every chair, mixing navy trousers and pleated navy-plaid skirts, no crests, no badges, no text, no people.

cards.edit: Edit the existing corridor photo: move all windows to the wrong side of the corridor and tilt the floor sideways, with dense dark banyan tree branches and leaves pressing against the glass from outside.

cards.title: 只剩你沒位置
cards.whisper: 大家都坐好了，就你沒有。

edits.corridor: Edit the existing corridor photo: line up many pairs of white sneakers and canvas shoes in two neat rows along both walls of the corridor, empty with no people, no faces.
edits.door: Edit the existing door photo: place one single lonely wooden student chair alone outside the classroom door facing the door, empty with no people.
edits.classroom: Edit the existing classroom photo: drape a short-sleeved white Taiwanese school shirt with navy trim over the back of every chair (mixed with navy trousers for boys and pleated navy-plaid skirts for girls, a few bow ties, a few navy and dark-red jackets, no crests, no badges, no names), push every desk away to leave one single desk isolated alone in the middle, with every chair turned away from it, no people, no faces, no readable text.

cards.edit: Edit the existing corridor photo: line up many pairs of white sneakers and canvas shoes in two neat rows along both walls of the corridor, empty with no people, no faces.

cards.title: 不叫名字的背影
cards.whisper: 祂站在走廊底，從不回頭。
cards.title_en: The Back That Never Calls You
cards.whisper_en: He stands at the end, never turning.

edits.corridor: Edit the existing corridor photo: add a dark out-of-focus adult silhouette far away at the very end of the corridor with its back turned to the camera, standing before a window showing a large banyan tree canopy outside, no face, no other people.
edits.classroom: Edit the existing classroom photo: drape a dark adult teacher coat over the lectern and turn every student chair in the room to face directly at the camera, empty room with no people, no faces, no readable text.

cards.edit: Edit the existing corridor photo: add a dark out-of-focus adult silhouette far away at the very end of the corridor with its back turned to the camera, standing before a window showing a large banyan tree canopy outside, no face, no other people.

cards.title: 午睡時的全班
cards.title_en: The Whole Class at Nap Time
cards.whisper_en: Shadows lying down, with no one there.

edits.corridor: Edit the existing corridor photo: cover the floor with long dark shadows of a whole class of standing students with nobody casting them, empty corridor with no people, no faces.
edits.door: Edit the existing door photo: pile tall stacks of blank off-white test papers with red pen marks and no readable text, no letters, no numbers up to the ceiling on both sides of the doorway, narrowing the entrance, no people.
edits.classroom: Edit the existing classroom photo: cast overlapping dark shadows of a full class sitting at desks across the floor and desks with nobody casting them, and pile tall stacks of blank test papers with red pen marks and no readable text on every desk, no people, no faces, no readable words.

card.title: 又變小了
card.whisper_en: The desks were always this tall.

ending.comment: 一個人回來，我看見了。小小的你很努力，桶歪了也好，名次遮不住你。
ending.comment_en: You came back alone, I saw you. Little you tried so hard. The bucket's crooked, that's fine — rankings can't cover you.
